name: swarm of quippers
desc: Swarm of Quippers is a CR 1 beast.

actions.name: blood frenzy
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm} has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

actions.name: swarm
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm} can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm} can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny quipper. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: water breathing
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm} can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: bites
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: [[/attack]], 0 ft., one creature in the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm}'s space. Hit: [[/damage 4d6 piercing average]] damage, or [[/damage 2d6 piercing average]] damage if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm} has half of its hit points or fewer.
